title: Daikon and Pork Soup
ldIngredientsRaw: 500 gram daikon (Indonesian: lobak), peeled and cut into bite size pieces
400 gram pork (ribs or loin), cut into bite size pieces
15 gram salted dried cuttlefish (Indonesian: sotong kering asin)
ldInstructionsRaw: Place all ingredients in a soup pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour or until both the daikon and pork are tender and fully cooked.
Turn off heat, serve hot and garnish with sliced scallions.
